Definition (EN): under official supervision after a conviction
Quote from Episode: Because I'm on probation, yo.
台词翻译: 因为我在缓刑期，老兄。
Example Sentence: Convicted fraud suspects usually serve probation.
例句翻译: 判了欺诈的一般都是缓刑。
Usage Note: 刑法律语；也指员工试用/察看期 probation period。

Definition (EN): restored to good standing after wrongdoing
释义（中文）: 已改过自新的；被改造好的
Quote from Episode: Gotta prove to the man I'm rehabilitated.
台词翻译: 我得让法官相信我已经改好了。
Example Sentence: He finished rehab and now counts as rehabilitated.
例句翻译: 他做完了戒毒疗程，现在算改过自新了。
Usage Note: 形容词 rehabilitated；名词 rehabilitation。法律＋医疗两义。

Definition (EN): a morally respectable member of society
Quote from Episode: Upstanding citizen.
台词翻译: 守法公民。
Example Sentence: His record made him an upstanding citizen again.
例句翻译: 履历干净，他又成了守法公民。
Usage Note: upstanding＝正直的。常反讽用，指表现得太正经。

Definition (EN): to be very difficult to do
Quote from Episode: That one's a bitch.
台词翻译: 那个动作可难了。
Example Sentence: That last part of the route is a bitch.
例句翻译: 最后那段路可难走了。
Usage Note: 粗俗但极常用。名词 a bitch＝难缠的事／难对付的人。

Definition (EN): to make you realise something is possible
Quote from Episode: you really opened my eyes to the possibilities
台词翻译: 你真是让我看到了各种可能性。
Example Sentence: That trip opened my eyes to how much I had been missing.
例句翻译: 那趟旅行让我意识到自己错过了多少。
Usage Note: 固定搭配。＝开眼界。反义 close your eyes to。

Definition (EN): to connect you with what you need
Quote from Episode: I can hook you up with some pseudo.
台词翻译: 我能帮你弄到点伪麻黄碱。
Example Sentence: Can you hook me up with a decent contractor?
例句翻译: 你能给我推荐个靠谱的装修队吗？
Usage Note: 职场常用。hook up 还有「勾搭上」义，看语境。

Word / Phrase: wouldn't miss it for the world
Definition (EN): absolutely would attend
Quote from Episode: Wouldn't miss it for the world.
台词翻译: 这种场合我绝不会缺席。
Example Sentence: I wouldn't miss the all-hands for anything.
例句翻译: 全员会我肯定到场。
Usage Note: 强表态。＝for the world 也可作 for anything（无论如何）。

Definition (EN): emphasising the first quality over the second
释义（中文）: （怀）孕太显了，相比之下美不美就…了
Quote from Episode: these days a little more big than beautiful
台词翻译: 这几天比起好看来更像胖了。
Example Sentence: Right now she's more tired than cheerful.
例句翻译: 她现在是累多过开心。
Usage Note: 这是婉转说法：不好直说某状态。＝rather than。

Definition (EN): to be naturally drawn to
Quote from Episode: I gravitated toward education.
台词翻译: 我自然就往教育这条路上走了。
Example Sentence: He gravitated toward research rather than sales.
例句翻译: 他自然倾向做研究而不是销售。
Usage Note: gravitate to＝受吸引。名词 gravitation。

Definition (EN): out of practice; no longer sharp
Quote from Episode: You're a little rusty, but you're not seeing the upside here.
台词翻译: 你是有点生疏了，但你看不出这事的价值。
Example Sentence: My C is rusty. I'd have to look up the basics.
例句翻译: 我 C 语言荒废了，基础都得现查。
Usage Note: 字义是生锈的。引申技能退步。反义 sharp。

Definition (EN): the beneficial side of something
Quote from Episode: you're not seeing the upside here
台词翻译: 你看不到这件事的好处。
Example Sentence: The downside is the cost; the upside is the data.
例句翻译: 代价是花钱，好处是拿到数据。
Usage Note: 反义 the downside（弊端）。upsides and downsides 很常见。

Definition (EN): inability to see alternatives
Quote from Episode: You get tunnel vision.
台词翻译: 你就会钻进牛角尖里出不来。
Example Sentence: Months on one problem gave her tunnel vision.
例句翻译: 在一个问题上耗了几个月，她就钻牛角尖了。
Usage Note: 也指生理上的视野狭窄。职场批评常用。

Definition (EN): to consider unconventional approaches
释义（中文）: 跳出框框思考；打破常规
Quote from Episode: One guy thinking outside of the box
台词翻译: 就差一个跳出框框想问题的人。
Example Sentence: Hiring him would get them thinking outside the box.
例句翻译: 招他进来能让他们跳出框框想问题。
Usage Note: 源自玩具「外盒思考」，创新/招聘高频。

Definition (EN): a thin excuse to cover something embarrassing
Quote from Episode: Kind of like some fig leaf, you know?
台词翻译: 有点像一块遮羞布。
Example Sentence: The donation was a fig leaf for the tax bill.
例句翻译: 那笔捐款是用来遮税单的。
Usage Note: 源自《创世纪》中亚当夏娃用无花果叶遮羞。

Definition (EN): allowing someone to avoid embarrassment
释义（中文）: 保全面子的；下得了台的
Quote from Episode: Some face-saving bullshit that allowed me to generously accept his charity
台词翻译: 那是给我留面子的鬼话，让我好意思收下他的施舍。
Example Sentence: They offered him a lateral move as a face-saving gesture.
例句翻译: 他们给他一个平级调岗，算是保全面子。
Usage Note: save face＝保全面子（面子）；lose face＝丢脸。英式更常用。

Definition (EN): to reduce to the essentials
Quote from Episode: When it came right down to it, I didn't know what else to do but tell him the truth.
台词翻译: 真到那份上，我除了说实话没别的办法。
Example Sentence: It comes down to cost per unit, not total spend.
例句翻译: 归根结底是单位成本，不是总花费。
Usage Note: it comes down to X＝关键就是 X。也作 boil down to。

Definition (EN): bluntly and without softening
Quote from Episode: he flat-out offered to pay for my treatment
台词翻译: 他直接提出要付我的治疗费。
Example Sentence: She flat-out refused the transfer.
例句翻译: 她当场就拒绝了调岗。
Usage Note: flat-out lie／refuse＝赤裸裸的。也可作 flatly。

Word / Phrase: talk your way out of something
Definition (EN): to escape a consequence by talking
Quote from Episode: I could've talked my way out of it.
台词翻译: 我本来能靠说辞躲过去的。
Example Sentence: He talked his way out of the speeding ticket.
例句翻译: 他靠狡辩躲掉了超速罚单。
Usage Note: talk one's way into/out of sth。搭配 talk someone out of。

Definition (EN): to hold them accountable afterwards
Quote from Episode: I'll deal with you later.
台词翻译: 回头我再跟你算。
Example Sentence: Let it go now; I'll deal with it tomorrow.
例句翻译: 先算了，我明天再处理。
Usage Note: threat 或拖延义。deal with＝处理、应付。

Definition (EN): minor problems of a new venture or teenager
Quote from Episode: Just growing pains.
台词翻译: 就是长大的烦恼而已。
Example Sentence: Early churn is normal growing pains.
例句翻译: 早期流失属于正常的成长烦恼。
Usage Note: 原指身体发育痛。创业/育儿/青春期通用。

Definition (EN): to obtain or procure it
Quote from Episode: Just a teenager trying to score some beer
台词翻译: 就是个想弄到啤酒的 teenager。
Example Sentence: Can you score us a taxi from here?
例句翻译: 你能从这儿帮我们叫到车吗？
Usage Note: 美式口语。＝get。score 也指得分／刮掉。

Definition (EN): six bottles or cans bought together
Quote from Episode: buy us a six-pack
台词翻译: 帮我们买六罐。
Example Sentence: He grabbed a six-pack and a twenty on the way home.
例句翻译: 他路上买了一提六罐和一包二十支。
Usage Note: a case（一整箱）≈ a twenty-four or thirty. 美式说 pack，英式说 pack of six。

Definition (EN): to get a lucky break
Quote from Episode: Guess you win the jackpot.
台词翻译: 算你走运吧。
Example Sentence: First interview and they hired him — he won the jackpot.
例句翻译: 第一次面试就被录了，他真是走运。
Usage Note: 反讽：其实是走了狗屎运。jackpot 原指老虎机 jackpot。

Definition (EN): to be competent and knowledgeable
Quote from Episode: You really know your shit.
台词翻译: 你还真懂行。
Example Sentence: He knows his shit when it comes to logistics.
例句翻译: 物流这块他很在行。
Usage Note: 粗俗但常作称赞。know what you're doing 同类。

Definition (EN): items made of glass, especially lab or tableware
Quote from Episode: I used to have, like, twice as much glassware
台词翻译: 我以前玻璃器皿有现在两倍多。
Example Sentence: The lab lost half its glassware in the move.
例句翻译: 搬迁时实验室丢了一半玻璃器皿。
Usage Note: 不可数。ware 作后缀＝器皿（software／hardware）。

Definition (EN): to crash off the road into a ditch
Quote from Episode: my dumbass ex-partner drove us into a ditch
台词翻译: 我那个蠢前搭档把车开进了沟里。
Example Sentence: He spun out and drove into a ditch.
例句翻译: 他打滑失控开进了沟。
Usage Note: drive someone into a ditch 也可引申为「毁了某人计划」。

Definition (EN): a long passionate speech
Quote from Episode: All you had to do was mention the Bunsen burner and he was off on a rant.
台词翻译: 你只要一提本生灯，他就开始滔滔不绝。
Example Sentence: She went on a rant about the new expense policy.
例句翻译: 她对新报销制度发了一通牢骚。
Usage Note: go off on a rant／rant about。derail a rant＝打断。

Definition (EN): looking refined and dignified
Quote from Episode: because he thought it made him look more distinguished
台词翻译: 因为他觉得那样显得更有气派。
Example Sentence: The crest made the blazer look properly distinguished.
例句翻译: 有了徽章，这件西装外套才显得够体面。
Usage Note: 形容外表/举止有身份感。动词 distinguish＝区分。

Definition (EN): the essential thing that keeps something going
Quote from Episode: This was our lifeblood.
台词翻译: 这就是我们的命根子。
Example Sentence: Cheap freight is the lifeblood of the model.
例句翻译: 低成本物流是这个模式的命脉。
Usage Note: 通常不加 a：the lifeblood of。＝命脉所在。

Definition (EN): to make illegal or forbid officially
Quote from Episode: I thought they'd been outlawed years ago
台词翻译: 我以为几年前就被取缔了。
Example Sentence: The state outlawed the practice in 2019.
例句翻译: 该州 2019 年取缔了这一做法。
Usage Note: 动词＝宣布非法；名词 outlaw＝逃犯。outlawed 形容词。

Definition (EN): an expression giving nothing away
Quote from Episode: I don't have the best poker face these days
台词翻译: 我最近这张脸藏不住事了。
Example Sentence: She kept a poker face through the whole interview.
例句翻译: 整场面试她都面无表情。
Usage Note: 源自打牌不露牌。keep a poker face＝不动声色。

Definition (EN): to insistently ask them
Quote from Episode: He knew something was wrong with you and he pressed me.
台词翻译: 他知道你不对劲，就追着我问。
Example Sentence: She pressed him for a straight answer.
例句翻译: 她逼他给个明确答复。
Usage Note: 职场追问＝施压。press for details／press someone on sth。

Definition (EN): the only warning you will get
释义（中文）: 最后一次警告；下不为例
Quote from Episode: Consider this your first and last warning.
台词翻译: 就算你第一次警告，也是最后一次。
Example Sentence: She gave him his first and last warning in front of the team.
例句翻译: 她在全组面前给了他最后一次警告。
Usage Note: warn someone off／give someone a final warning。语气很硬。

Definition (EN): to have the resources to act
Quote from Episode: We're in business.
台词翻译: 咱们有得搞了。
Example Sentence: With two investors in, they're in business.
例句翻译: 有两个投资人进场，他们就有的做了。
Usage Note: ≠「营业中」。字面是「有资本/门路」。
